# packages

> Return catalog metadata for a specified package name.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var packages = require( '@stdlib/namespace/packages' );
```

#### packages( pkg )

Returns catalog metadata for a specified package name.

```javascript
var out = packages( '@stdlib/math/base/special/sin' );
// returns {...}
```

The returned object has the following properties:

-   **description**: package description.
-   **alias**: REPL alias (empty string if none).
-   **type**: value type (e.g., `'Function'`, `'number'`; empty string if not in the REPL namespace).
-   **related**: array of related package names.
-   **hasCliTool**: `boolean` indicating whether the package provides a CLI.
-   **hasNativeAddon**: `boolean` indicating whether the package has a native addon.
-   **hasWasm**: `boolean` indicating whether the package ships a WebAssembly binary.

If provided an unrecognized package name, the function returns `null`.

```javascript
var out = packages( 'unrecognized_pkg_beep_boop_bop_bip' );
// returns null
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var packages = require( '@stdlib/namespace/packages' );

var keys;
var pkg;
var o;
var i;

keys = [
    '@stdlib/math/base/special/sin',
    '@stdlib/array/float64',
    '@stdlib/stats/base/dists/normal/pdf',
    '@stdlib/array/base/accessor'
];

for ( i = 0; i < keys.length; i++ ) {
    pkg = keys[ i ];
    o = packages( pkg );
    if ( o ) {
        console.log( '%s: %s (alias: %s)', pkg, o.description, o.alias || 'none' );
    } else {
        console.log( '%s: not found', pkg );
    }
}
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
